 Prime Video’s cryptic message puts Panchayat season 5 in doubt
 A mysterious post sparks speculation after Banrakas takes charge of Phulera in season 4
 Published
 5 hours ago on
 November 15, 2026 
 By
 indiantelevision.com Team 
 Follow us on Google News 
 Follow us on WhatsApp 
 Share 
 Tweet 
 MUMBAI: The pradhan’s chair may have changed hands, but the biggest question in Phulera is now hanging in the air: will there be another season of Panchayat? Prime Video has set the rumour mill rolling with a cryptic new message that has left fans wondering whether the village’s story is heading towards another chapter or its final goodbye.
 The streaming platform’s latest move has fuelled speculation about the future of the popular series, without offering a clear answer on whether season 5 is on the cards. For a show that has turned the everyday politics, rivalries and relationships of a small Uttar Pradesh village into appointment viewing, the uncertainty has given viewers plenty to talk about.
 The questions come in the wake of season 4, which ended with a significant shift in Phulera’s political landscape. Pradhan Ji, played by Raghubir Yadav, and Manju Devi, portrayed by Neena Gupta, lost their positions, clearing the way for a new leadership at the village panchayat.
 Kranti Devi, played by Sunita Rajwar, stepped into the pradhan’s chair, with her husband Bhushan Sharma, better known as Banrakas and played by Durgesh Kumar, firmly by her side. The change has put a new power equation in place, with Banrakas seemingly ready to make his influence felt across Phulera.
 And that could mean a very different village in the next chapter. The man who has long been a source of friction in Phulera’s political and social circles now finds himself closer to the centre of power. With Kranti Devi as pradhan and Banrakas playing a prominent role, the familiar tussles that have driven the show’s humour and drama could take an interesting turn.
 For viewers, the prospect of Banrakas’ growing influence is an obvious talking point. Season 4’s leadership change has opened up fresh possibilities for the characters, particularly as the village adjusts to a new administration. Whether the next season explores this political transition or takes the story in an entirely different direction remains unknown.
 However, Prime Video’s cryptic message should not be mistaken for confirmation that the series has been cancelled. Equally, it does not amount to an announcement of a fifth season. The platform has not provided a definitive update on the show’s continuation in the information available so far.
 That leaves Panchayat fans in familiar territory: waiting for the next development in Phulera. Only this time, the suspense is not about who will occupy the pradhan’s chair, but whether audiences will get to return to the village at all.
 For now, Banrakas may have the reins of Phulera, but the final word on Panchayat’s future remains with Prime Video.
